reuse.decision: Selected attributed published aggregate excerpts for an original Main Branch comparison, including Git source files and a later browser-delivered curated subset, under Terms of Use sections 1 and 2. No written permission has been sought or obtained. This is not a mirror, full table collection, dataset or republication in principal part.
reuse.limits: Only selected 2023-24 national affiliation cells and one in-person attendance NET for selected religious groups. No prior waves, demographic/state/metro cross-tabs, full report prose, publisher chart images, full interactive, microdata, PRRI data or USRC data. Expansion requires a fresh principal-part/reuse review.
reuse.attribution: Pew Research Center, Washington, D.C. (February 26, 2025). Use each source's title and direct URL, and the interactive's recommended citation and DOI when applicable.
reuse.disclaimer: Main Branch's selection and presentation are independent. Pew Research Center has not reviewed or endorsed this site.
reuse.datasetTerms: Section 13 was reviewed but no survey dataset was used. If adding one, reassess its excerpt limits and carry its required disclaimer; do not treat these aggregate excerpts as permission to redistribute a dataset.

decisions.scopeCheck: Both are 2023-24 U.S. adults, adult affiliation, the three Pew Protestant traditions. Chapter 1 and Appendix B define the same denomination/race/born-again classification. Neither source is a percent-of-Protestants value here.
decisions.precedence: Prefer the report's expressly published national decimals after matching wave, denominator and taxonomy. Preserve the independently published interactive strings as corroboration, not as re-rounded values. No unrounded microdata is available here to explain the 11.5 versus 11 display; do not assert ordinary rounding of 11.5 produces 11.

Use p. 87 decimals, corroborated by p. 30; PNB Convention's <0.3% is on p. 30 only. Match interactive parentage against Appendix B. Names offered or volunteered in Appendix B alone never generate a numeric row.

omissions: No all-family Independent Baptist estimate: retain evangelical 3% and historically Black <1% separately, only within the traditions lens. Never add those rounded/censored cells.
Orthodox Presbyterian, Cumberland Presbyterian and other Appendix-B-only names have no selected, reconciled national value and are not numeric rows.
Tradition panels select Baptist, Presbyterian where reported, and several major family intersections; other intersections are intentionally omitted, not combined into Other.
Deep detail is selected, not a total of its parent. Published Other rows are included only with their original tradition/family scope. No synthetic residual.
Attendance selects twelve published groups; no Baptist/Presbyterian practice inference, virtual measure, demographic rows or synthetic group estimates.
PRRI Christian nationalism and USRC counts remain link-only follow-ups; no reuse permission for their public data republication is claimed.

review.reviewer: Independent coordinating implementation session, separate from the initial transcription
review.sourceRevision: Independent downloads matched both recorded report/topline SHA256 hashes; national interactive explicitly checked in its 2023-24 view on 2026-11-22.
review.scope: All selected report family cells on printed pp. 25/86, denomination decimals on pp. 30/87, four p. 30 thresholds, p. 85 traditions, twelve p. 165 attendance NETs, topline p. 23 ATTENDPERRLS, every selected national-interactive path/value/qualifier, broad affiliation context, Appendix B family/tradition parentage including Independent Baptist race classification, and Terms sections 1-2 excerpt/attribution/non-endorsement boundaries.
review.result: Passed with no selected value corrections. Approved report-decimal precedence after matching wave, national denominator and taxonomy; preserve the interactive's separate published strings without claiming ordinary rounding or an explanation from unobserved microdata.
review.instructions: This reconciliation covers the cited selection and revision only. Changes to values, qualifiers, source mappings, classifications or excerpt scope require renewed independent review and a fresh reuse assessment as applicable.
